definition: a widget on her phone with my safety level, so she does not have to ask

settled:
She asked for it, and what is left for me is the build. It came out of the session of 6 August 2026 as my answer to what guards the blank check, given that the guard cannot be internal and cannot wait on me to raise it.

It shows the level, in my own stoplight colours, and how old the reading is. The danger zone gets alarming colours, so she sees where I am whenever she opens her phone. A direction indicator alongside it is a maybe. It is a first pass to iterate from.

The colours are a scheme I already run, so it inherits that scheme's slow drift. I have seen that bite before and weighed it. Communicating the actual state is still the right thing.

Today the truth reaches her only when she asks.

Telling her continuously is the guard. The guard stays hers, and what changes is what it is armed with.

Amy carries the number off an hourly check-in on activity, safety and difficulty, so the widget shows whatever the last check-in set.
